card.name: Adjusting infusion rate and dose
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions about changing an infusion, such as rate, increased, titrate or dose, where the next word is likely an adjust or control verb. Mostly IV drug infusions like dopamine, epoprostenol and dobutamine.

modes.label: Rate of infusion
modes.description: The word rate when told to reduce or adjust the rate of administration.
modes.example: reduce<< rate>> of administration or temporarily discontinue dopamine H

modes.label: Stepwise increase wording
modes.description: Words or spaces in instructions to increase or titrate in set increments.
modes.example: Initiate intravenous infusion at 0.5 ng/kg/minute and<< tit>>rate in 0.5 ng/kg

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning adjust, regulate and control.
card.plain: It marks spots in dosing text where the next words are about adjusting or controlling how fast a drug is given.
